description: This PHP source file defines the StudentT class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing statistical distribution functions for Student's T distribution, including distribution calculation and inverse (t-quantile) computation.

classes.name: StudentT
classes.description: A class providing methods for calculating Student's T distribution probabilities and inverse distributions.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the probability of Student's T distribution for given value, degrees of freedom, and tails.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of Student's T distribution (quantile) for a given probability and degrees of freedom.

methods.name: calculateDistribution
methods.description: Private method implementing the core calculation for the Student's T distribution probability.
